Button.name: Button
Button.doc: A button. `type` defaults to `button` (never an accidental submit); `loading` disables it, shows a spinner and sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `primary` (default), `secondary`, `danger` or `ghost`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
Checkbox.doc: A labelled checkbox (a consent, a yes/no setting): the box before its label, the hint and the error under it, wired with `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` like every field, so the error is announced with the box.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label (the app's own, already translated text).

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether it is checked (bindable).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the box.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the box as required (label suffix and `aria-required`): a consent that must be given.

Combobox.name: Combobox
Combobox.doc: A combobox (WAI-ARIA APG editable combobox with list autocomplete) on the native `popover`: typing filters the options and opens the list; Arrow Down/Up move the active option (focus stays in the input, `aria-activedescendant`), Enter chooses it, Escape closes the list and a second Escape clears the text, Alt+Arrow Down opens without moving. Leaving the field restores the chosen option's label. With `filter={false}` the app supplies `options` for the text it gets in `onquery` (a server search).

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label.

props.name: options
props.doc: The options.

props.name: value
props.doc: The chosen option's value, or `null` (bindable).

props.name: filter
props.doc: Filters `options` by the text (default: contains, ignoring case), or `false` when `options` are already filtered.

props.name: onquery
props.doc: Called with the text whenever it changes (for a server search).

props.name: onchange
props.doc: Called after an option was chosen.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows the loading text instead of "no results" while the app fetches options.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the input.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The input's placeholder (already translated).

props.name: item
props.doc: Renders an option's content (default: its label as text), e.g. a second line; never render server text as HTML.

DateField.name: DateField
DateField.doc: A labelled date input on the native `input type=date`: the browser supplies the localized format, the picker and its keyboard support. The value is an ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, as a backend `DateOnly` is serialized) or `null` when empty.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label.

props.name: value
props.doc: The date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `null` (bindable).

props.name: min
props.doc: The earliest date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: max
props.doc: The latest date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the input.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

Dialog.name: Dialog
Dialog.doc: A modal dialog on the native `<dialog>`: the browser traps focus, makes the page inert and closes it on Escape. Focus returns to the element that opened it. A click on the backdrop closes it unless `dismissible` is false.

props.name: open
props.doc: Open state (bindable).

props.name: title
props.doc: The heading, the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Backdrop click and Escape close it. Default `true`.

props.name: children
props.doc: The body.

props.name: footer
props.doc: Actions at the bottom (buttons).

props.name: onclose
props.doc: Called after it closed, however it closed.

Field.name: Field
Field.doc: Label, hint and error around one control. The control snippet receives the ids to wire: `id`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`, so the error is announced with the field.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label (the app's own, already translated text).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the control.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text (already translated, e.g. `t(form.error(path))`); shown and announced when set.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required (label suffix and `aria-required`).

props.name: control
props.doc: The control.

MenuButton.name: MenuButton
MenuButton.doc: A menu button (WAI-ARIA APG menu button) on the native `popover`: Enter, Space or Arrow Down open the menu on its first item, Arrow Up on its last; Arrow keys move (wrapping), Home/End, Enter or Space choose, Escape closes and returns focus to the button, Tab closes. A click outside closes it (light dismiss). Use it for actions, not for choosing a value.

props.name: items
props.doc: The actions, in order.

props.name: children
props.doc: The button's content (text, or an icon with a `VisuallyHidden` text).

props.name: onselect
props.doc: Called with the chosen item's id; the menu is closed by then.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `secondary` (default) or `ghost`.

NumberField.name: NumberField
NumberField.doc: A labelled number input; the bound value is a `number`, or `null` when empty.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value (bindable); `null` when the input is empty.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the input.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

RadioGroup.name: RadioGroup
RadioGroup.doc: A choice from a few options as radio buttons in a `fieldset` (a `radiogroup` named by its legend): the arrow keys move the choice (native), every option is a target of at least 44 px, hint and error are wired with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible legend (the app's own, translated text).

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { readonly value: V; readonly label: string; readonly hint?: string | undefined }[]
props.doc: The choices: the backend's value, its text and an optional line of help.

props.name: value
props.doc: The chosen value, or `null` (bindable).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the legend.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the group as required.

Select.name: Select
Select.doc: A labelled choice from a list on the native `select` (keyboard, type-ahead and the phone's picker come from the browser). The value is the chosen option's `value`, or `null` while the placeholder is shown.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { readonly value: V; readonly label: string }[]
props.doc: The choices: the backend's value (e.g. an enum member) and its text (the app's own, translated).

props.name: value
props.doc: The chosen value, or `null` (bindable).

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The text of the empty first entry (e.g. "Choose …"); it cannot be chosen again.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the select.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

Skeleton.name: Skeleton
Skeleton.doc: A placeholder with a fixed size, so content that arrives later does not shift the layout (philosophy P1).

props.name: width
props.doc: Width, any CSS length. Default `100%`.

props.name: height
props.doc: Height, any CSS length. Default `1em`.

Spinner.name: Spinner
Spinner.doc: A loading indicator. Decorative by default (`label` omitted); with a `label` it is announced as a status.

props.name: size
props.doc: The size, any CSS length. Default `1.25rem`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Announced text; without it the spinner is hidden from assistive technology.

Tabs.name: Tabs
Tabs.doc: Tabs (WAI-ARIA APG tabs, automatic activation): one tab stop for the tab list; Arrow Left/Right move and select (wrapping), Home/End go to the first and last tab. Only the selected panel is rendered; it is focusable so its content can be reached with Tab. More tabs than fit scroll inside the tab list; the focused tab scrolls into view.

props.name: tabs
props.doc: The tabs, in order.

props.name: selected
props.doc: The selected tab's id (bindable). Default: the first tab.

props.name: label
props.doc: The tab list's accessible name (already translated).

props.name: children
props.doc: Renders the selected panel; receives the selected id.

props.name: onchange
props.doc: Called after the selection changed.

TextField.name: TextField
TextField.doc: A labelled text input (`type` text, email, password, search, tel, url, or time: `HH:mm`, the browser's picker).

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value (bindable).

props.name: type
props.doc: The input type. Default `text`.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text under the input.

props.name: error
props.doc: The error text, already translated.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

ThemeRoot.name: ThemeRoot
ThemeRoot.doc: The root of the design system: sets `.t-root` (tokens apply only inside it), the theme, density and motion, the message catalogue for its subtree, and the notification region. Nothing outside it is touched.

props.name: theme
props.doc: `light`, `dark`, or `auto` (follows `prefers-color-scheme`). Default `auto`.

props.name: density
props.doc: `comfortable` (default) or `compact`.

props.name: motion
props.doc: `auto` (default) follows `prefers-reduced-motion`; `reduce` sets the duration tokens to 0 in the subtree, so no colour or size changes animate: an in-app "reduce motion" setting, and the recipe for tests that run axe right after a change (a running transition is a mixed colour, which axe can report as `color-contrast`).

props.name: locale
props.doc: The language of the subtree (`lang` attribute), e.g. `de`. Default `en`.

props.name: messages
props.doc: The catalogues, tried in order: the app's own first, then a built-in one (`en`, the default, or `de` from this package). Only the catalogues an app passes are bundled.

Toaster.name: Toaster
Toaster.doc: The notification region of a ThemeRoot (rendered by it). Errors are announced assertively, the others politely.

AppShell.name: AppShell
AppShell.doc: The page frame: a skip link, a header with the app's name and actions, an optional navigation and the main landmark. Below 40rem the navigation is stacked above the page (`navPosition="side"`, the default) or a one-row bar at the bottom of the viewport, in thumb reach (`navPosition="bottom"`: its list items share the row, each target at least 44 px high; the shell is then exactly the viewport's height and the page scrolls in the main landmark, never under the bar).

props.name: title
props.doc: The app's name in the header.

props.name: navLabel
props.doc: The navigation's accessible name (the app's own text); the nav is rendered when `nav` is set.

props.name: nav
props.doc: Navigation links (a `<ul>` of links, or links).

props.name: navPosition
props.doc: Where the navigation goes below 40rem: stacked above the page (`side`, default) or a bar at the bottom (`bottom`).

props.name: actions
props.doc: Header actions (user menu, sign-out).

props.name: children
props.doc: The page.

Calendar.name: Calendar
Calendar.doc: A calendar of days with entries: a month grid (entries as dots), a week (the days in rows with their entries) and a day. The month and week are WAI-ARIA grids with one tab stop: Arrow keys move by a day (Up/Down by a week in the month), Home and End go to the first and last day of the week, Ctrl+Home/End to the first and last day of the month, Page Up/Down to the previous and next month (Shift: year; in the week view: week). Enter or Space activates a day: `onselect`, or the day view when there is no `onselect`. A day's accessible name is its full date and entry count (`aria-labelledby` a visually hidden text); it contains the visible number, so axe's `label-content-name-mismatch` holds. Days are ISO strings `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: label
props.doc: The calendar's accessible name (the app's own text, e.g. "Calendar").

props.name: date
props.doc: The focused day, `YYYY-MM-DD` (bindable). Default: today.

props.name: view
props.doc: The view (bindable). Default `month`.

props.name: views
props.doc: The views to offer; one view shows no switch. Default all three.

props.name: entries
props.doc: The entries of a day, in display order. Default: no entries.

props.name: entry
props.doc: Renders an entry's text (in the week and day views, after its dot).

props.name: tone
props.doc: The dot colour of an entry. Default `accent`.

props.name: day
props.doc: Extra content of a day in the week and day views, before its entries (e.g. "5 children expected").

props.name: onselect
props.doc: Called when a day is activated (Enter, Space, click). Without it, the day view opens (when offered).

props.name: locale
props.doc: The locale of the date texts (`Intl`), e.g. the ThemeRoot's `de`. Default `en`.

props.name: firstDay
props.doc: The first day of the week: 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. Default 1 (Monday).

props.name: today
props.doc: Today, `YYYY-MM-DD` (marked with `aria-current="date"`). Default: today in the browser's time zone.

props.name: dots
props.doc: Dots shown in a month cell before "+n". Default 3.

ChangeForm.name: ChangeForm
ChangeForm.doc: A `<form>` around a `changeForm(...)`: Enter submits, the submit button shows the pending state, and a violation that belongs to no field (403, 409, malformed body) is shown and announced above the button, with the request's reference (`Tarol-Request-Id`) for a user to quote; the reasons of a refusal (`reasons`) are listed under its message, and a warning to confirm (Tarol-Net TN-37) gets a Confirm button that sends the same input again with `Tarol-Confirm`.

props.name: form
props.doc: The form from `changeForm(...)`.

props.name: submitLabel
props.doc: The submit button's text (the app's own).

props.name: children
props.doc: The fields.

props.name: actions
props.doc: More buttons next to submit (e.g. cancel).

DataTable.name: DataTable
DataTable.doc: A table over a keyset `list(...)`: column headers that switch the backend sort, a "load more" button for the next page, and virtual scrolling above `virtualizeAbove` rows (only the visible rows are in the DOM). Cells are a snippet, so any formatting or component fits. It is a WAI-ARIA data grid: one tab stop; arrow keys move between cells, Home/End to the row's ends, Ctrl+Home/End to the first and last cell, Page Up/Down by 10 rows (scrolling virtual rows into the DOM). A cell with one widget (a link, a button, the sort button) focuses that widget instead of the cell.

props.name: list
props.doc: The list from `list(...)`.

props.name: columns
props.doc: The columns, in order.

props.name: cell
props.doc: Renders one cell.

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: A stable key per row (usually the id).

props.name: caption
props.doc: The table's accessible name (the app's own text).

props.name: sort
props.doc: The backend sort value in use (bindable): the list's request should read it.

props.name: virtualizeAbove
props.doc: Render only visible rows when there are more than this. Default 200 (docs/migration/design.md).

props.name: filter
props.doc: Shows only the rows it keeps (a client-side narrowing the backend's equality filters cannot express, e.g. a time range); paging, `hasMore` and `more()` stay the list's. Default: every row.

props.name: rowHeight
props.doc: The fixed row height in px used for virtual scrolling. Default 40.

props.name: maxHeight
props.doc: The height of the scroll area when virtualized. Default `70vh`.

DetailLayout.name: DetailLayout
DetailLayout.doc: The page of one aggregate over a `query(...)` of its view: a heading from the value, optional facts (`meta`), actions (e.g. a `MenuButton`) and an aside, with loading, error and stale states from `QueryState`. The heading is the page's `h1`; while the first read runs a skeleton of the same height holds its place (no layout shift).

props.name: query
props.doc: The view, from `query(...)`.

props.name: title
props.doc: The heading of the loaded value (already translated where needed).

props.name: children
props.doc: The main content.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Short facts under the heading (status, dates).

props.name: actions
props.doc: Actions next to the heading.

props.name: aside
props.doc: A side column (related lists, history); below the content on narrow screens.

FormField.name: FormField
FormField.doc: One field of a `changeForm(...)`, bound by its backend field path (`reserve`, `lines[1].quantity`). The error shown is the client rule's or the server's code, as a message from the catalogue with the bounds of the client rule, or of the server's detail (`errorDetails`, `1..1000000`) when the field has no client rule for the code. When the form has the option `from`, a value that changes on the server while the user edits the field shows a polite notice with "Use the new value" / "Keep mine"; the input and the focus stay as they are.

props.name: form
props.doc: The form from `changeForm(...)`.

props.name: path
props.doc: The backend field path.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label (the app's own text).

props.name: type
props.doc: `text` (default), `number`, `email`, `password`, `tel`, `url`; `checkbox` (a boolean member, e.g. a consent); `select` or `radio` (one of `options`, `null` until chosen); `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) or `time` (`HH:mm`), `null` when empty. A select, a radio group and a box are touched on the change.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { readonly value: string; readonly label: string; readonly hint?: string | undefined }[]
props.doc: The choices of a `select` or `radio` field: the backend's value (an enum member) and its text.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The empty first entry of a `select` (e.g. "Choose …").

props.name: rules
props.doc: The field's rules: their bounds fill the message (`Enter between {min} and {max} characters.`).

props.name: hint
props.doc: Help text.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required.

QueryState.name: QueryState
QueryState.doc: Loading, empty, error and stale states around a query or list from `@clorat/tarol-svelte`. While the first read runs it shows skeletons of a fixed height (no layout shift); an error shows the code's message and a retry; the content stays visible while revalidating.

props.name: state
props.doc: The query or list.

props.name: children
props.doc: The content, rendered once there is a value (or at least one item).

props.name: empty
props.doc: Replaces the default empty text.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Replaces the default skeletons.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Skeleton rows while the first read runs. Default 3.

SearchBox.name: SearchBox
SearchBox.doc: The global search box over the backend's `MapTarolSearch` entry (`GET /search?q=…`): a `Combobox` that asks the server as the user types (debounced, the previous request aborted) and lists the hits: the title, and under it the backend's snippet with the matched words in `<mark>`. Choosing a hit calls `onselect` with it, e.g. to navigate to its aggregate. Every server text is rendered as text: the snippet is plain text with highlight ranges (UTF-16 offsets), never markup.

props.name: label
props.doc: The visible label (the app's own text).

props.name: onselect
props.doc: Called with the chosen hit.

props.name: path
props.doc: The search entry's path. Default `/search`.

props.name: types
props.doc: Only these searchable types (the `types` parameter). Default: every type the user may read.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Hits per request (the backend allows at most 50). Default 8.

props.name: minLength
props.doc: Characters before the first request. Default 2.

props.name: debounce
props.doc: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke. Default 150.

props.name: describe
props.doc: Shows a type's name next to a hit's title, e.g. `(type) => t('type.' + type)`. Default: the title only.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: The input's placeholder (already translated).

props.name: snippets
props.doc: Asks for snippets and shows them under the titles. Default `true`.

AdminApp.name: AdminApp
AdminApp.doc: The admin UI over Tarol's admin entry (`MapTarolAdmin`): dead letters (re-drive, discard), projection versions (drop a superseded one) and a data subject (export, erase). Mount it on a route of your app inside `ThemeRoot`, after `setTarol(client)`; the user needs the backend's admin role (`tarol-admin` in the sample), else every section shows the 403 `Auth.Forbidden` message. It adds no global state; its texts come from `messages` (default `adminEn`) in front of the app's catalogue.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Where the backend mapped the admin entry. Default `/tarol/admin`.

props.name: messages
props.doc: The admin texts and codes, e.g. `adminDe`. Default `adminEn`.

props.name: tenant
props.doc: The tenant the data-subject section starts with. Default the empty GUID (data without a tenant).

props.name: section
props.doc: The open section (bindable): `dead`, `projections` or `subject`.
